outcome: maternal outcomes (blood loss, scar dehiscence/rupture uterus)
cohort: Pregnant women with prior cesarean section
finding: While mifepristone use for IOL in women with prior C-sections did not significantly impact mode of delivery or major maternal/fetal outcomes compared to spontaneous labor, it did increase the need and dose of oxytocin required.
mod_finding: Mifepristone use for IOL in women with prior C-sections did not significantly impact mode of delivery compared to spontaneous labor.
